text: Bill lives with his rich parents and sister in a Beverly Hills mansion and tells his therapist he does not trust them. A secretly recorded tape seems to capture [his family at a murderous orgy|wrong|broken trust], then changes into his sister's debutante party when he plays it again. Friends die and come back, his therapist drugs him, and at a formal party at home he learns what the elite truly are, as guests [melt into one mass of flesh|images|wounded and changing bodies] to [feast on a living young man|wants|feeding on the living].
